rejectedCards.why: 抽卷/翻卷宗是单人静物动作，撑不起「装进来」这个机械感

prompt.image: dark olive depot at night, bone paper inventory tag, thick barcode, red rubber stamp, conveyor, top-left volumetric light, graphic poster lighting, no text. Palette bg:#080d0a, surface:#151f19, paper:#f2ebdc, accent:#c9f45b, warning:#ff6a3d, stamp:#df4a33. Type NotoSansSC 900/Geist/Geist Mono. Motifs: paper tag, barcode, steel crate, red stamp, perforated steel. Composition: leave deliberate negative space for a headline; no readable text, no logos, no letters.
prompt.video: 盘点/审计: 入库口 → 建账 → 翻账 → 减重 → 点名 → 入库. Motion: conveyor, magnetic snap, stamp impact, tool roll, lid flip. Transition: 机械快门. Captions: 左下入库标签. Sound: 机械音. Hook pattern: 给 [对象] 装了这么多，你还记得几件？. Avoid the reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, transition combination, caption animation, motifs and SFX arrangement.
prompt.cover: 3:4 poster, huge bone paper tag in lower half, red stamp, barcode, top negative space for headline, dark steel depot. Hook: 提问. Hero motif: paper tag. Brand block at bottom; keep key text in the top 75% and the right 120px clear. Render all text in HTML/SVG, not in the generated image.
prompt.negative: reference film's exact copy, shot order, durations, light sweep, halftone wipe, flash white, center keyword sticker, metal title slam, riser/whoosh/shimmer, gibberish Chinese text, logos, watermarks
